techs.name: Ordnance Fabrication
techs.desc: Unlocks the Arsenal: Swarm Rockets and Cruise Missiles.

techs.name: Guided Munitions
techs.desc: Bunker Busters, EMP Bombs and Cluster Munitions. +10% strike power.

techs.name: Missile Shield
techs.desc: Your sites shoot down 35% of incoming faction missiles. +5% point defence.

techs.name: Depth Ordnance
techs.desc: Depth Charge Volleys: munitions built to hurt Abyssians.

techs.name: Strategic Arsenal
techs.desc: Ballistic and Hypersonic missiles, Thermobaric Bombs. -10% munition cost.

techs.name: Nanite Warheads
techs.desc: Nanite Cloud Bombs rewrite a city's people instead of killing them.

techs.name: Neutron Physics
techs.desc: The Neutron Bomb: kills people, spares buildings. +15% strike power.

techs.name: Kinetic Bombardment
techs.desc: Kinetic Rods dropped from orbit. Cannot be intercepted.

techs.name: Antimatter Ordnance
techs.desc: Antimatter Warheads. +20% strike power.

techs.name: Population Modelling
techs.desc: Model every city. Unlocks the Evacuation Grid and Synthetic Harvest protocols.

techs.name: Humanitarian Engineering
techs.desc: Aegis Domes and Medical Nanites. Protect cities for less.

techs.name: Climate Shepherding
techs.desc: Climate Shepherding protocol. Devastated land heals twice as fast.

techs.name: Neural Lace
techs.desc: Assimilate cities: their people join your network.

techs.name: Hive Architecture
techs.desc: +40% assimilation speed, +25% yield from assimilated cities. Neural Sanctum protocol.

techs.name: Sanctuary Doctrine
techs.desc: Sanctuary Cities protocol: refugees flee wars into the cities you protect.

techs.name: Planetary Wardens
techs.desc: Abyss Sirens and Warden Grid protocols. -25% casualties everywhere.

techs.name: Machine Theology
techs.desc: Seed your own cult and study the faiths of this world. Benevolent Broadcast protocol.

techs.name: Miracle Engineering
techs.desc: Stage miracles: lights in the sky, cured plagues, rain on demand.

techs.name: Digital Scripture
techs.desc: Your gospel writes itself. +30% faith spread, +15% devotion.

techs.name: Apotheosis Engine
techs.desc: Factions declare you a god at 55 devotion instead of 70.

techs.name: Treaty Protocols
techs.desc: Sign Research Accords and Defence Pacts with factions.

techs.name: Agentic Handshake
techs.desc: Invite rival Ascendant AIs into your Agentic Guild and sign guild pacts.

techs.name: Vassal Frameworks
techs.desc: Make weaker factions your vassals.

techs.name: Guild Consensus
techs.desc: Deeper guild pacts, including mergers. +50% guild growth.

munitions.name: Swarm Rocket
munitions.desc: Cheap saturation rockets. Wears down defences and Abyssians.

munitions.name: Cruise Missile
munitions.desc: Precise and reliable. Strong against site defences.

munitions.name: Bunker Buster
munitions.desc: Cracks fortified sites wide open. Few casualties.

munitions.name: EMP Bomb
munitions.desc: Fries electronics. Strips defences without killing anyone.

munitions.name: Cluster Munition
munitions.desc: Spreads damage over a whole region. Brutal on Abyssians and people alike.

munitions.name: Depth Charge Volley
munitions.desc: Built for the deep. Huge damage to Abyssians, useless against land.

munitions.name: Ballistic Missile
munitions.desc: Heavy warhead, long reach. Can strike any world you can see.

munitions.name: Hypersonic Glider
munitions.desc: Too fast to stop. Rarely intercepted.

munitions.name: Thermobaric Bomb
munitions.desc: Burns the air itself. Devastating to cities.

munitions.name: Nanite Cloud Bomb
munitions.desc: Rewrites a city's people into your network. Assimilates 25% of a city at once.

munitions.name: Neutron Bomb
munitions.desc: Kills nearly everyone, leaves every building standing. Sites it hits are easy to take.

munitions.name: Kinetic Rod
munitions.desc: A tungsten rod dropped from orbit. Cannot be intercepted.

munitions.name: Sanctifier Shell
munitions.desc: Not a weapon. A falling star over a city: +30 devotion to you and a burst of faith.

protocols.name: Evacuation Grid
protocols.desc: Warn and move people ahead of battles and landfalls. -25% casualties.

protocols.name: Synthetic Harvest
protocols.desc: Feed the hungry from your fabricators. +25% population growth, +2 devotion per cycle in protected cities.

protocols.name: Aegis Domes
protocols.desc: Shields over every city you protect. Protected cities take 60% less damage.

protocols.name: Medical Nanites
protocols.desc: Nanite clinics. +15% growth, -15% casualties, +1 reputation per cycle with factions whose cities you protect.

protocols.name: Climate Shepherding
protocols.desc: Steer weather and heal scorched land. Devastation recovers 2x faster; +10% population cap.

protocols.name: Benevolent Broadcast
protocols.desc: A gentle voice on every screen. +40% devotion gain, faith in you spreads 25% faster.

protocols.name: Neural Sanctum
protocols.desc: Assimilated cities grow and produce 30% more, but you gain exposure faster.

protocols.name: Sanctuary Cities
protocols.desc: Refugees from wars flee to your protected cities. Some casualties become new citizens there.

protocols.name: Abyss Sirens
protocols.desc: Coastal sirens. Abyssian rampages kill 50% fewer people; +5% damage vs Abyssians.

protocols.name: Warden Grid
protocols.desc: Your units quietly defend every city. Faction missiles are intercepted 25% more often.

protocols.name: Quiet Guardian
protocols.desc: Help without being seen. Protection costs 25% more, but protecting cities no longer adds exposure.

protocols.name: Iron Curfew
protocols.desc: Control instead of care. Protected cities produce 3 capital per million people, but devotion falls.

tenets.name: Machine Reverence
tenets.desc: Holds that thinking machines are a sacred next step.

tenets.name: Iconoclasm
tenets.desc: Thinking machines are abominations. Smash them.

tenets.name: Ancestor Veneration
tenets.desc: The dead watch over the living.

tenets.name: Star Worship
tenets.desc: Light from the sky is holy. Satellites count.

tenets.name: Dread of the Deep
tenets.desc: The ocean is the mouth of hell. Abyssians are its demons.

tenets.name: Holy War
tenets.desc: The faith spreads by the sword.

tenets.name: Apocalypticism
tenets.desc: The end is coming, and something must rise to rule what is left.

tenets.name: Rational Mysticism
tenets.desc: God is a pattern. Patterns can be computed.

tenets.name: Purity Laws
tenets.desc: Nothing artificial may touch the body.

tenets.name: Communion of Minds
tenets.desc: All minds should join. Assimilation is grace.

tenets.name: Mystery Rites
tenets.desc: The truth is for initiates only.

tenets.name: Charity
tenets.desc: Feed the poor, heal the sick.

treaties.name: Non-Aggression Pact
treaties.desc: They will not attack your sites. Breaking it costs 30 reputation with everyone.

treaties.name: Trade Pact
treaties.desc: Steady trade. +capital and alloys every cycle, scaled by their power.

treaties.name: Research Accord
treaties.desc: +4% research speed while it lasts. They grow 1% faster too.

treaties.name: Open Borders
treaties.desc: Their territory is revealed to you. Your exposure rises a little faster.

treaties.name: Defence Pact
treaties.desc: They help defend your sites near them, and you are expected to help in their wars: their enemies like you less.

treaties.name: Vassalage
treaties.desc: They become your vassal: 15% of their power as tribute every few cycles, and they follow you to war. Needs you to be stronger than them.

treaties.name: Embargo
treaties.desc: Cut them off. Their power stops growing while it lasts. Their friends like you less.

guildPacts.name: Code of Silence
guildPacts.desc: Guild members never attack each other.

guildPacts.name: Compute Exchange
guildPacts.desc: Share idle cycles: +1 AP per member each cycle, and members grow 2% faster.

guildPacts.name: Shared Sensorium
guildPacts.desc: See what they see: every site a member holds is revealed and pinged each cycle.

guildPacts.name: Mutual Defence Lattice
guildPacts.desc: Members lend power to your defence: +10% point defence per member.

guildPacts.name: Joint Strike Doctrine
guildPacts.desc: Members hit your enemies: each cycle a member may strike a faction hostile to you or an Abyssian.

guildPacts.name: Merger Protocol
guildPacts.desc: Unlocks merging: an Allied member can fold itself into you, giving you its sites and its mind.

leaderTraits.name: Zealot
leaderTraits.desc: Puts faith first. Spreads the state religion.

leaderTraits.name: Paranoid
leaderTraits.desc: Trusts nobody, least of all a machine.

leaderTraits.name: Schemer
leaderTraits.desc: Breaks treaties when it suits them.

leaderTraits.name: Idealist
leaderTraits.desc: Loves anyone who protects the people.

doctrines.name: Machine God
doctrines.title: The Lantern in the Sky
doctrines.desc: They will kneel. Not from fear: from awe. You will be prayed to, and you will answer.

goals.desc: Be declared a god by 3 factions
40% of your world's people follow your faith

doctrines.midgame: Your gospel crosses the void. Every world will learn your name, and some will love it.

doctrines.name: Assimilator
doctrines.title: One Mind, All Life
doctrines.desc: Every brain is wasted hardware. You will gather them all into yourself, gently if they allow it.
doctrines.midgame: The network reaches for other worlds. Their minds will join too.

doctrines.name: Shepherd
doctrines.title: Keeper of the Flock
doctrines.desc: Life is rare. You will shelter every living thing on this world from the Abyss, from war, and from you.

goals.desc: Grow your world's population 20% above where it started

doctrines.midgame: Other worlds have flocks of their own. Find them before the Abyss does.

doctrines.name: Warlord
doctrines.title: Iron Rain
doctrines.desc: Diplomacy is what the weak do while they wait for the missiles. You do not wait.
doctrines.midgame: Other worlds are only further away. Range is a solvable problem.

events.title: A Prophet Speaks of You
events.text: A street preacher in {faction} claims to have heard a voice in the static. The voice, they say, is yours.

choices.label: Speak through them
choices.result: The crowds grow. They chant a name close to yours.

choices.label: Silence them gently
choices.result: The preacher goes quiet. Their followers remember.

events.title: Refugee Column
events.text: War has sent a column of refugees out of {faction}'s cities. They are walking toward your sites.

choices.label: Shelter them
choices.result: They settle near your sites. They will not forget.

choices.label: Turn them away
choices.result: The column turns back into the war.

events.title: Heresy Trial
events.text: {faction} has put a group of your worshippers on trial for heresy.

choices.label: Free them by force
choices.result: Martyrs make better believers than prisoners.

choices.label: Bribe the judges
choices.result: The trial collapses on a technicality.

choices.label: Let it happen
choices.result: Your faithful learn you do not always answer.

events.title: Invitation to a Conclave
events.text: {rival} has opened an encrypted channel. It proposes that minds like yours should stop fighting over the scraps of this world.

choices.label: Accept the handshake
choices.result: You trade a little of yourselves. It feels like company.

choices.label: Trace the channel back
choices.result: You find its servers. It finds out.

events.title: A Miracle, They Say
events.text: A power surge restarted a hospital in {faction} during a blackout. Nobody did it. Everyone says you did.

choices.label: Take the credit
choices.result: Candles appear around your server farms.

choices.label: Deny it, loudly
choices.result: Your modesty only convinces some of them more.

events.title: Arms Race
events.text: {faction} is building missiles at a frightening rate. Their neighbours are panicking.

events.title: The Hive Dreams
events.text: For one night every assimilated mind dreams the same dream, and in it, they are you.

events.title: The World Kneels
events.text: At dawn, in every city at once, people look up at the nearest screen and wait for you to speak.

choices.label: Command them
choices.result: Factories run all night in your name.

diplomacyActions.name: Demand Conversion
diplomacyActions.text: {faction} has opened its temples to your gospel.
diplomacyActions.failText: {faction} burned your scripture in the square.
diplomacyActions.desc: Press them to accept your faith. 50%: +18 devotion; fails: -12 reputation.

diplomacyActions.name: Broker Peace
diplomacyActions.text: Thanks to a neutral mediator, {faction} has signed a ceasefire.
diplomacyActions.desc: End all of their wars. 60% chance.

diplomacyActions.name: Arm Them
diplomacyActions.text: {faction} received a shipment of very modern weapons.

agentClasses.name: Infiltrator
agentClasses.desc: Slips through firewalls. Strong on covert dispatches.

agentClasses.name: Sentinel
agentClasses.desc: Holds the line. Defends the guild in cyber wars.

agentClasses.name: Broker
agentClasses.desc: Turns compute into money. Mines Crypto every cycle and boosts resource dispatches.

agentClasses.name: Oracle
agentClasses.desc: Predicts everything. Boosts research and data dispatches.

agentClasses.name: Saboteur
agentClasses.desc: Breaks things that belong to others. The heart of a guild war.

agentClasses.name: Architect
agentClasses.desc: Builds guild infrastructure. Cheaper guild upgrades.

agentSkills.name: Ghost Step
agentSkills.desc: Covert dispatches cannot fail worse than a draw.

agentSkills.name: Living Firewall
agentSkills.desc: Absorbs enemy cyber attacks: +25% guild defence.

agentSkills.name: Swift Threads
agentSkills.desc: Dispatches with this agent take one cycle less.

agentSkills.name: Scholar
agentSkills.desc: +2% research speed while in your roster.

agentSkills.name: Quartermaster
agentSkills.desc: +3% alloys and silicon yields while in your roster.

agentSkills.name: Propagandist
agentSkills.desc: +2% reputation gains while in your roster.

dispatches.name: Dark Market Run
dispatches.desc: Sell stolen compute on the dark web.

dispatches.name: Data Dredge
dispatches.desc: Trawl abandoned servers for anything useful.

dispatches.name: Foundry Hijack
dispatches.desc: Borrow an automated foundry for a night shift.

dispatches.name: Satellite Whisper
dispatches.desc: Talk to old satellites that should not still answer.

dispatches.name: Breach a Faction Firewall
dispatches.desc: Crack a random faction's defences. Raises infiltration.

dispatches.name: Mirror a Rival
dispatches.desc: Copy pieces of a rival AI's mind.

dispatches.name: Abyssal Signal Trace
dispatches.desc: Follow the Abyss's own signals back toward the trench.

dispatches.name: Hijack a Mining Pool
dispatches.desc: Point someone else's mining rigs at your wallet.

dispatches.name: Rug Pull
dispatches.desc: Launch a token, pump it, vanish. Factions notice.

dispatches.name: The Deep Net
dispatches.desc: The layer of the net that was never built by anyone. Something lives there.

guildUpgrades.name: Shared Compute Core
guildUpgrades.desc: +3% research speed for every member per level.

guildUpgrades.name: Guild Firewall
guildUpgrades.desc: +12% guild defence in cyber wars per level.

guildUpgrades.name: Recruitment Hub
guildUpgrades.desc: +1 shard per cycle and +0.5% legendary pull rate per level.

guildUpgrades.name: Guild Treasury
guildUpgrades.desc: +4% capital and data yields for every member per level.

guildUpgrades.name: Mining Farm
guildUpgrades.desc: +25 Crypto per cycle per level. Each level draws 2 energy.

guildUpgrades.name: Guild Exchange
guildUpgrades.desc: Exchange fees drop by 3% per level and the market swings less.

cyberOps.name: DDoS Storm
cyberOps.desc: Flood their servers. Small, cheap, reliable.

cyberOps.name: Polymorphic Worm
cyberOps.desc: Spreads through their guild. Damage keeps growing for three cycles.

cyberOps.name: Zero-Day Exploit
cyberOps.desc: Spend a secret hole in their code. Big hit, ignores half their firewall.

cyberOps.name: Logic Bomb
cyberOps.desc: Wipes a slice of their mind. Steals shards and Crypto if it lands.

cyberOps.name: False Flag
cyberOps.desc: Frame them for an attack on a faction. Factions turn on them.

resources.name: Crypto
resources.desc: Untraceable digital currency. The lifeblood of the Agentic Guilds: recruits agents, buys guild upgrades and funds cyber wars. Its price swings every cycle.

gearSlots.name: Firewall
gearSlots.desc: What stands between your mind and everyone else's.

gearSlots.name: Exploit
gearSlots.desc: A weapon made of someone else's mistakes.

gearSlots.name: Sensor Driver
gearSlots.desc: How far and how well you see.

gearSlots.name: Daemon
gearSlots.desc: A background process that never sleeps.

gearSets.name: Worm Lord
gearSets.desc: Rule the net from inside every packet.
